objective: Test whether A-share research and screening generates stable reproducible risk-adjusted excess return after verified dated costs against a frozen benchmark. No profit guarantee or evidence claimed.

candidate_universe.selection_bias: OWNER_PRESELECTED_CONTEMPORARY_SURVIVOR_SAMPLE; not whole-market edge evidence; membership/listing must be PIT

Quality.rule: TTM revenue growth >0 AND TTM gross margin change >=0 AND ROIC > versioned contemporaneous cost-of-capital estimate

Financial Quality.rule: TTM net income >0; TTM operating cash flow / TTM net income >=0.8; contemporaneous net debt / TTM EBITDA <=3; EBITDA>0

Valuation.rule: positive chosen multiple percentile <=0.6 within trailing1260 actual sessions; weak rank count(x<=current)/N, require1260 valid PIT observations

Catalyst.rule: verified issuer/exchange structured event of ORDER_AWARD,CAPACITY_COMMISSIONING,POSITIVE_PROFIT_GUIDANCE published and available within last60 actual sessions, not rescinded/expired; expiry expires60 sessions after publication, exact intraday precision required

Risk.rule: NO hard negative, UNKNOWN status, integrity conflict, thesis invalidation or missing critical evidence; historical tradability policy must pass independently

Evidence Quality.rule: every required feature has PIT exact available/retrieved/source hash/version/units and full window; reconstruction labelled separately; issuer official evidence cannot be vendor substitute

Timing.rule: FAMILY_SPECIFIC_BELOW; all feature windows end at decision cutoff; MA arithmetic means, slope MA60(t)-MA60(t-20); ATR20 mean true range of20 sessions using raw comparable action-reconciled prices; prior highs exclude today; RS20 stock total return minus contemporaneous sector total return

Edge.rule: predeclared scenario expected gross return minus dated round-trip fees/slippage and uncertainty buffer >=400bps; net edge / round-trip cost >=5; zero-cost denominator cannot imply infinite pass

families.origin: FORMAL_HANDOFF_CORE_PULLBACK_EXAMPLE; thresholds frozen as proposal only
families.entry_rule: ALL_COMMON_GATES AND close>MA60 AND MA60(t)-MA60(t-20)>0 AND sectorRS20>0.03 AND 0<=abs(close-MA20)/ATR20<1 AND mean(volume,last3)/mean(volume,last20)<0.8 AND close>max(high,previous3 sessions)
families.entry_execution: NEXT_EXCHANGE_OPEN_SESSION_AFTER_EOD_DECISION, subject to actual tradeability; never same bar

families.origin: FORMAL_HANDOFF_CORE_BREAKOUT_EXAMPLE; thresholds frozen as proposal only
families.entry_rule: ALL_COMMON_GATES AND close/max(high,previous60 sessions)-1>0.005 AND volume/mean(volume,previous20 sessions)>=1.5 AND sectorRS20>0 AND 0<=close/breakout_reference-1<=0.03
families.entry_execution: NEXT_EXCHANGE_OPEN_SESSION_AFTER_EOD_DECISION, subject to actual tradeability; never same bar

model_selection: NO WINNER SELECTION AFTER REVEAL; both declared families incl failures retained; third requires new pre-reveal registration, no retroactive addition

exit_rule.research_proposal: earliest next exchange session after thesis/hard-risk invalidation or close<=entry_price-2*ATR20(entry); otherwise close<MA20 after20 held sessions or time exit after40 sessions; T+1 and halt/limit may delay actual hypothetical sale

allow_flat_rule.rule: no qualifying complete candidate => cash; missing prerequisites => NO_DECISION

rebalance_frequency.proposal: EOD decision daily; research evidence re-evaluate every20 sessions or material event; no mandatory daily trade

position_rule.proposal: max3positions; target20% equity each, total<=60%; quantity floored to verified lot, fees inclusive; no averaging down; exits before lexical-symbol entries shared cash

kill_conditions.research_proposal: drawdown>=0.10 disables new entries; no automatic liquidation; data/status/ledger/source/cost integrity failure immediately NO_NEW_ENTRIES

evaluation.benchmark_proposal: CSI300 TOTAL_RETURN licensed versioned series; index identifier and total-return action/tax methodology must be proved, not price-only proxy
evaluation.diagnostic_control_proposal: equal_weight_three_symbol_total_return_with_cash, exact pilot; selection biased, not market benchmark

retrospective_split.minimum_history: 5 years; target1260 actual sessions, handoff minimum
retrospective_split.OOS_claim: NONE; all retrospective data potentially exposed, including prior WaveE observed three-stock results; cannot label these unseen OOS
retrospective_split.boundaries: dates only partition sessions; not midnight publication clocks

future_OOS_proposal.end_rule: at least126 actual sessions plus minimum independent completed trades; insufficient => INCONCLUSIVE

evaluation.walk_forward_protocol: expanding36month IS +12month validation +next6month sealed test, move6months; purge40 actual sessions at label boundaries, embargo40 sessions; no tuning in this preregistered two-family evaluation, all windows reported and retrospective exposure labelled
evaluation.grade_probability_calibration: at least50 independent complete OOS/Paper trades per grade; otherwise exploratory, no 85score probability claim
evaluation.transaction_cost_treatment: verified dated commission/minimum/tax/exchange fee inclusion/other fees plus separately specified BASE and PESSIMISTIC slippage/partial fill; UNKNOWN blocks economic evaluation; optimistic sensitivity not primary
evaluation.multiple_testing_policy: two fixed confirmatory families, report both failures/successes; family-wise alpha0.05 Bonferroni per family0.025; no winner selection, no undisclosed variants; dependence-aware block bootstrap plan requires pre-reveal implementation review, no iid-trade p-values
success_criteria_proposal: sufficient independent unseen OOS samples; exposed retrospective cannot fulfill
fee-inclusive OOS excess return >0 in BASE and PESSIMISTIC, simultaneous confidence lower bound >0 under frozen multiplicity protocol
OOS max drawdown <=0.10 and no integrity violation
same preregistered method evaluated across all declared windows; do not discard failed windows
failure_criteria: negative excess or breached drawdown with enough unseen observations => FAILURE
missing data/policy/sample or unimplemented statistical protocol => INCONCLUSIVE/BLOCKED; neverPASS
